description: This source file defines the internal class `TicTacToeState` which manages the state and game logic for a Tic Tac Toe game in an Android application. It handles game moves, state persistence via bundle, score tracking, and game reset functionalities.

classes.name: TicTacToeState
classes.description: Manages the game's current state, logic, and persistence for Tic Tac Toe within an Android context.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles a player's move at a specific cell, updates game state, checks for win/draw, and returns outcome.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the game board to initial empty state, retains scores.

methods.name: resetScores
methods.description: Resets the win and draw scores without clearing the current game board.

methods.name: saveToBundle
methods.description: Serializes the game state into a Bundle for Android lifecycle persistence.

methods.name: restoreFromBundle
methods.description: Restores the game state from a Bundle after process recreation or configuration change.
